description: Use when someone sets up a PCR or qPCR reaction mix for several wells. Calculates volume of each component per reaction and for the whole mix with excess, with water filling the remaining volume. Give each component a stock and final concentration (molar, ng/µL, x buffer, %), an amount per reaction (e.g. 1.25 U polymerase from 5 U/µL, 10 ng template from ng/µL), or a fixed volume. Template can be added per well separately. Do not list water; it is calculated.

inputSchema.description: Input contract for the Verbex PCR and qPCR master mix calculator. Water is calculated automatically to fill each reaction.

components.description: Master mix components except water (water fills the remaining volume). Give each either a stock and final concentration (or amount per reaction), or a fixed volume per reaction.

finalConcentration.description: Final concentration in the reaction (same kind of unit as the stock), or an amount per reaction (U, ng, pmol) when the stock is a concentration.

name.description: Component name, e.g. '2x SYBR Green mix', 'Forward primer', 'Taq polymerase'.

stockUnit.description: Stock unit: molar, mass per volume, U/µL for enzymes, x for fold buffers, % for percent.

volumePerReaction.description: Use instead of stock/final to add a fixed volume per reaction.

excessPercent.description: Extra master mix to cover pipetting loss, as a percent of the reactions.

reactionName.description: Name for the master mix, e.g. 'IL-6 qPCR plate 2'.

reactionVolume.description: Total volume of one reaction, including template.

templateVolume.description: Template volume added to each well separately (not in the master mix).

templateVolumeUnit.description: Defaults to the reaction volume unit.

name: pcr_master_mix

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: PCR / qPCR master mix
